records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The additional week resulted in higher net revenue, gross margin dollars, research and development expense, and selling, general and administrative expense in the first fiscal quarter of fiscal year 2024, compared to the corresponding current year fiscal period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our semiconductor solutions segment increased in the fiscal quarter ended February 2, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal period due to strong demand for our networking products, primarily AI networking solutions, partially offset by lower demand for our non-AI solutions, primarily broadband products.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net revenue from our infrastructure software segment increased in the fiscal quarter ended February 2, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal period primarily due to strong demand for our VMware Cloud Foundation (“VCF”) product, additional license revenue recognized on contracts where customers do not have the right to terminate, and the transition to a subscription license model.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin was $10,145 million for the fiscal quarter ended February 2, 2025 compared to $7,375 million for the fiscal quarter ended February 4, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income from our semiconductor solutions segment increased for the fiscal quarter ended February 2, 2025 compared to the prior year fiscal period due to strong demand for our networking products, primarily AI networking solutions, partially offset by lower demand for our non-AI solutions, primarily broadband products.
